name: iris-ai

scripts.pack: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:linux:appimage: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:linux:deb: npm run icons && npm run compile && electron-builder --linux deb
